Expected results

  • Step 4: when the dialog closes, focus returns to a sensible place (you can see it and keep working without the mouse). Write down where it went.
  • Step 5: after Golf Co leaves the filtered results and the board is refreshed, the keyboard user can carry on: one press of Tab lands on a visible element (for example the "Skip to main content" link). Write down where.
  • Step 6: after Ben becomes inactive and the board is refreshed, the keyboard user can carry on: one press of Tab lands on a visible element. Write down where.
  • Where focus should go is not designed yet. A refresh always starts focus at the top of the page, so focus being at the top right after the refresh is normal and is not a fault (QA lead's decision below). Pass if focus is visible, or becomes visible with one Tab, and the keyboard user can carry on. Fail only if focus cannot be seen and Tab does not bring it to a visible element.

Source — where this behaviour comes from

  • Epic SV-10043; story SV-10054 (Story 11, Keyboard access and focus); PRD Confluence 845185030, edited 7 Oct 2026 (status line "PRD v33"), S11-R6, S11-E1, S11-E2, Story 11 user story, read 8 Oct 2026. Review Decisions page 853901313, SQ-15 (Open) and UX-19 (Open). Inline PRD comment by Slavcho Mitrov, 28 Sep 2026, lists what is still open with design. Tech plan (revised 24 Sep 2026) Phase 11.
  • QA lead decision, 12 Oct 2026: focus starting at the top of the page after a refresh is accepted while the focus design is pending; no defect.
